name: Jirfine Intelligent Equipment Co Ltd
summary: JirFine Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd., established in 2009 and based in Dongguan, China, is a company dedicated to the innovation, production, and sale of advanced Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machine tools. The firm offers a comprehensive selection of precision manufacturing equipment. This includes high-speed drilling and tapping centers, various types of machining centers (such as vertical, gantry, horizontal, and composite models), precision carving and engraving machines, as well as vertical turning centers and CNC lathes. JirFine's sophisticated machinery supports a broad spectrum of industries. Its clientele spans sectors like general equipment manufacturing, consumer electronics, automotive components, mold fabrication, construction machinery, defense, energy, medical devices, aerospace, and 5G communication, among others.
